{{Quote|I think we should name the new unit the Five-oh-First&hellip; They're supposed to be the best. If we're going to take this job, we might as well aim high.|[[Taxtro Grave]], [[0 ABY]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The '''501st Legion''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Legion/Legends|unit]] in the [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]]. The original [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], an elite unit composed primarily of [[Clone stormtrooper|clone soldiers]] from the [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] [[Clone template/Legends|template]], was indirectly involved in the creation of the unit that shared the same designation. At the behest of [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the [[Hand of Judgment]]&mdash;a group of renegade [[Trooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[Daric LaRone]], [[Korlo Brightwater]], [[Taxtro Grave]], [[Saberan Marcross]] and [[Joak Quiller]]&mdash;trained a new 501st Legion that was open to both [[Reproduction/Legends|birth-born]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Alien/Legends|aliens]].

Although the original 501st ceased to exist as a result of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|collapse]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|First Galactic Empire]], its counterpart ultimately survived and ensured that the 501st remained a unit of elite Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].

The official reconstitution of the 501st was conducted by Senior [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]],<ref name="CSWE stormtrooper">{{CSWECite|III|193|Stormtrooper}}</ref> in accordance with Thrawn's wish to see the legion revived in the Empire of the Hand.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Detachments of the legion included [[Unit Aurek-Seven]], a stormtrooper [[Squad/Legends|squad]] that participated in the Empire of the Hand's [[Capture of the Warlord|liberation]] of [[Kariek]].<ref name="SQ" />

==History==
{{Quote|But while they are excellent soldiers, they and I both agree that they can become better. They can become true Imperial stormtroopers.''"<br />"''I have no doubt of that, sir. But surely the ''Admonitor'' already has its share of capable stormtroopers.''"<br />"''So it does. What it doesn't have are capable stormtroopers who can deal honestly and enthusiastically with the idea of aliens joining their ranks.|[[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Daric LaRone]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}After [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtrooper]] [[Daric LaRone]] shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] his [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[Major/Legends|Major]], he and a group of other stormtroopers went on the run from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. This group of deserters became known as the [[Hand of Judgment]]. It wasn't until when [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] noticed their abilities and friendliness to [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] that he offered them to train the next generation of stormtroopers for [[Empire of the Hand]].
